incentives.name: ImagiNE Act incentives barred for data centers (executive order)
incentives.what: Data centers cannot receive ImagiNE Act tax incentives; order formalizes a pause on data center development and creates a task force on land, water and electricity impacts with guardrails for future projects.

incentives.name: Data center sales/use tax and personal property tax exemption (LB 1080, 2012)
incentives.law: LB 1080 (2012); Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-202(10) and Nebraska Revenue Act (sec. 5 of LB 1080)
incentives.what: Sales and use tax exemption, and personal property tax exemption, for tangible personal property acquired by a data center operator in Nebraska that is assembled or incorporated into other property for later use at a location OUTSIDE Nebraska. Does not exempt equipment used in Nebraska. Operative Jan 1, 2013. Approved by the Governor April 10, 2012.

laws_and_bills.name: LB1261 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Requires data center operators to generate their own electricity behind the meter; excess can be sold to the grid (per Governor). Seen as enabling the Google/Tenaska gas-plant proposal.

laws_and_bills.name: LB1010 (2026), Large Load Customer Regulation Act
laws_and_bills.what: Adopts the Large Load Customer Regulation Act and provisions on cryptocurrency mining operations and data centers (amended in LB1193, LB1111, LB1064). Passed 49-0, approved by Governor April 14, 2026.
